question: Why do NPC greetings and barkers appear in speech balloons but never in retained chat?
nativeConsumer: FFOne gameplay_ui NPC speech messages and app/social_ingress retained history
findings: PrintName.SetChatBubble rejects null, empty and single-space text, then calls CnGuiChat.AddEventString(4, NPC name + colon + speech) BEFORE bBaloonChat is checked.
CnGuiChat.AddEventString gates type 4 through bEventMessage1; AddChatString routes it only to AllChatStrings.
Native greeting, mission/skill packet and autonomous barker producers previously only enqueued balloon state. ChatLineUi::npc had no production ingress from those edges.
contract: Publish one semantic speech event for each accepted live-owner greeting, network barker or autonomous barker, regardless of balloon visibility.
Drain events after the producer, honor npc_messages_in_chat, discard messages outside gameplay or without a local player, and retain only in the All history of the world/tutorial owner.

Resolve NPC name and body from independent semantic content keys in the current text locale, then use the existing ui.hud.chat.message.direct template. Historical resolved arguments retain the locale at receipt.
Preserve existing random chance, distance, timing, history capacity, bubble geometry, fonts, voice behavior and assets.
limitations: No new claims about missing audio takes, tutorial timeline dialogue or full PrintName visual parity.
No legacy binary payload was changed or published; FFClientEditor data-reversal defect was not found in this scoped case.
